title: Students Using Artificial Intelligence Technologies for Exams and Assignments
what_it_is: Students Using Artificial Intelligence Technologies for Exams and Assignments

sections.label: MOE guidance on AI learning
sections.summary: MOE gives educators in schools and IHLs guidance and resources to harness these technologies to enhance learning.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: These technologies are in our midst and will become more pervasive over time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Therefore, MOE provides educators in schools and IHLs with guidance and resources to effectively harness it to enhance learning.

sections.label: Assessment and AI detection
sections.summary: Teachers use multiple assessment modes and plagiarism detection strategies, including AI-detection tools, while students must acquire critical skills.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: In addition, teachers use multiple modes of assessment to gauge students' proficiency and detect uncharacteristic responses that could be AI-generated content.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: A wide variety of strategies are adopted to detect plagiarism in assignments, including technological tools to detect content generated by AI technology.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: These skills are not easily replaced by technological tools and acquired through leadership roles, interdisciplinary project work and various forms of experiential learning.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: And I must emphasise this, in this new world, the critical skill for our students to acquire are: how to discover, distil and to discern and if possible, create or develop something new in the process.

sections.label: Courses for educators on AI
sections.summary: Courses are already being conducted for educators to understand the potential and challenges of AI technologies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Indeed, we have a plan and we are already conducting courses for our educators to help them understand both the potential and the challenges of such AI technologies.

sections.label: Cheating not tolerated
sections.summary: Cheating is not tolerated in any education institutions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The answer to Dr Lim's question is this: cheating is cheating.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Cheating is not tolerated in any of our education institutions.

sections.label: Students must declare sources
sections.summary: Students are expected to declare truthfully where their sources of information may come from.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: And if some tools can help you to derive a better answer, so be it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: But we expect all our students to declare, truthfully, where their sources of information may come from.
